prompts.text: Name a country whose name starts with I

items.quip: Started in Singapore in 2014 and now runs across six countries.
items.title: Ninja Van
items.extract: Ninja Van is a Singaporean logistics company. Founded in 2014, the company engages in last mile logistics and package delivery. Ninja Van has sorting warehouses across Southeast Asia, in Singapore, Myanmar, Malaysia, Philippines, Indonesia, Thailand and Vietnam.

items.quip: Japan's black-cat courier behind takkyubin delivery.
items.title: Yamato-class battleship
items.extract: The Yamato-class battleships  were two battleships of the Imperial Japanese Navy, Yamato and Musashi. Their keels were laid down in 1937 and 1938, and they were commissioned as designed in 1941 and 1942. A third hull, laid down in 1940, was converted to the aircraft carrier Shinano during construction. Two further ships were planned but never constructed.

prompts.text: Name a country in Eastern Europe

items.quip: Renamed in 2019 to settle a 27-year naming dispute with Greece.
items.title: North Macedonia
items.extract: North Macedonia, officially the Republic of North Macedonia, is a landlocked country in Southeast Europe. It shares land borders with Greece to the south, Albania to the west, Bulgaria to the east, Kosovo to the northwest and Serbia to the north. It constitutes approximately the northern third of the larger geographical region of Macedonia. Skopje, the capital and largest city, is home to a quarter of the country's population of over 1.83 million. The majority of the residents are ethnic Macedonians, a South Slavic people. Albanians form a significant minority at around 25%, followed by Turks, Roma, Serbs, Bosniaks, Aromanians and a few other minorities.

prompts.text: Name a word for a huge number (million or bigger)

items.quip: Once the largest number ever used in a serious mathematical proof.
items.title: Skewes's number
items.description: Large number used in number theory
items.extract: In number theory, Skewes's number is the smallest natural number  for which the prime-counting function  exceeds the logarithmic integral function  It is named for the South African mathematician Stanley Skewes who first computed an upper bound on its value.

prompts.text: Name a tool you would find in a toolbox

items.quip: Two handles and one blade, made for shaping wagon-wheel spokes.
items.title: Spokeshave
items.extract: A spokeshave is a hand tool used to shape and smooth woods in woodworking jobs such as making cart wheel spokes, chair legs, paddles, bows, and arrows. The tool consists of a blade fixed into the body of the tool, which has a handle for each hand. Historically, a spokeshave was made with a wooden body and metal cutting blade. With industrialization metal bodies displaced wood in mass-produced tools. Being a small tool, a spokeshave is not suited to working large surfaces.

prompts.text: Name a chemical element lighter than iron

items.quip: Element 21, the first transition metal on the table.
items.title: Scandium
items.extract: Scandium is a chemical element; it has symbol Sc and atomic number 21. It is a silvery-white metallic element found in the d-block of the periodic table. Usually, it is classified as a rare-earth element, together with yttrium and the lanthanides. It was discovered in 1879 by spectral analysis of the minerals euxenite and gadolinite from Scandinavia.

prompts.text: Name a sport played without a ball

items.quip: Racers swim a Welsh peat bog without conventional strokes.
items.title: Bog snorkelling
items.description: Race thru a peat bog trench
items.extract: Bog snorkelling is a sporting event where competitors aim to complete two consecutive lengths of a 60 yards (55 m) water-filled trench cut through a peat bog in the shortest time possible, wearing traditional snorkel, diving mask and flippers. They complete the course without swimming, relying on flipper power alone.

items.quip: A Cotswold Olimpicks event contested since the 1600s.
items.title: Shin-kicking
items.extract: Shin-kicking, also known as shin diggings or purring, is a combat sport that involves two contestants attempting to kick each other on the shin in order to force their opponent to the ground. It has been described as an English martial art, and originated in England in the early 17th century.
